|game_text=While at Senate: Sidious is politics +3; "senators on Squabling Delegates is treated as "Coruscant Guards;" and may lose 1 Force to place Keder and an opponent's [Coruscant] Political Effect (or [Coruscant] senator here) in owner's Lost Pile.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Keder The Black (V)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB5-07-Keder_The_Black-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Keder The Black (V)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Keder The Black (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; the slip and the Players Committee card image print it): “While at Senate: Sidious is politics +3; “senators” on Squabbling Delegates is treated as “Coruscant Guards;” and may lose 1 Force to place Keder and an opponent’s [Coruscant] Political Effect (or [Coruscant] senator here) in owner’s Lost Pile.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of December 7, 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the release-sheet wording again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Keder The Black (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) dropped the closing quotation mark after “senators” and spelled “Squabbling Delegates” as “Squabling Delegates” (typo kept as published). PC-E1 text: “While at Senate: Sidious is politics +3; 'senators on Squabling Delegates is treated as 'Coruscant Guards;' and may lose 1 Force to place Keder and an opponent's [Coruscant] Political Effect (or [Coruscant] senator here) in owner's Lost Pile.”<ref name="cl-1250_9">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the same text is in the VMasterType list</ref> The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
